profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Recorded Future

positions.title: Backend Developer
positions.description:
Spearheaded development of new features in monolithic legacy Elixir application.
  - Architected custom tagging system to support complex SQL queries and bulk operations, resulting in acquisition of $750k client
  - Mitigated churn risk for large government client by implementing trend-based Executive Summary
  - Designed audit logging system to track critical system changes and user actions
  - Engineered project builder tool, enabling Sales Engineers to expedite project creation process by a significant margin

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend Elixir Software Engineer who helped maintain Covid-19 testing apps that had over 100k tests.  Maintained an in-house reporting and Lab Information system as well. 

- Augmented in-house Lab Information System to support new COVID-19 test kit to aid the opening of east coast in house lab
- Created two 3rd party lab integrations to help support demand during the peak of COVID-19

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Backend C# Software Engineer responsible for partnership API (Genomelink) integrations, load testing, automated UI testing, and backend development.


- Used AWS SQS, SNS, ECS and Lambda functions in distributed system for Genomelink integration to process different parts of the DNA process (validation, storage)
- Used AWS Step Functions in order to take advantage of built in exponential back off (in the case of reaching memory limits which were exposed by load testing)
- Created and maintained smoke tests built in Rainforest QA

positions.title: Junior Database Developer
positions.description: Created ETLs and hand rolled SQL to support the Medicare department.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintained and added various features to Clinical trial management system for vendors such as Strimvelis, MStops and PRA Health Sciences.

positions.title: Front End Developer Intern
positions.description: Responsibilities included developing responsive designs into HTML, CSS, and Javascript utilizing Bootstrap.  Implemented and wrote client side tests utilizing the Jest testing framework for the second iteration of the MojoPages app.

positions.title: Web/Social Content Manager
positions.description: Responsibilities include driving up traffic to Azmira's websites by renovating the the front end to make the user experience better.  Other tasks included managing the Google Adwords account to ensure a return of investment of at least a 3% click through rate for all campaigns.

positions.title: Certified Associate
positions.description: Responsibilities include educating customers about the store's products, providing holistic alternatives to medicine, carrying out transactions via Quickbooks, performing store opening and closing routines, and participating in inventory management.

positions.title: Teacher's Assistant
positions.description: Assisting the teacher and students with software to build Lego Comic Strips, Stop Film Animation, Basic App Development, Minecraft 3D modeling and basic 3D Game Design.

positions.title: Solutions Author
positions.description: Responsibilities include writing, formatting and solving textbook solutions to help other students understanding and knowledge.

positions.title: At-Home Advisor Pro
positions.description: Supporting and troubleshooting Apple product problems while also providing excellent customer service.

positions.title: Midshipman
positions.description: Responsibilities include completing a Personal Qualification System proving knowledge of USS Stennis on 3rd class Summer cruise.  Also included learning about the responsibilities of a Naval Officer while leading as a Squad leader for 8 midshipmen as a 2nd Class Midshipman.
